Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source activities, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno and molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter assay.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217643', standard_relation = '=', standard_value IS NOT NULL, standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
